HistoryRecord.title: HistoryRecord
HistoryRecord.description: An archived tweet record containing author, content, media, links, and engagement metrics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the record or tweet status ID

tweetUrl.description: Direct canonical link to the tweet on x.com

authorName.description: Display name of the tweet author

authorAvatarUrl.description: URL of the author profile picture

isVerified.description: Whether the author has a verification badge

text.description: Full text body of the tweet

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the tweet was posted

scannedAt.description: Timestamp when the extension scanned the record

syncedAt.description: Timestamp when the snippet was synced to SoroTrack database

sourcePage.description: URL of the page where the tweet was captured (e.g. x.com/i/history)

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered user profile with role-based access for administrative operations.

id.description: Unique user ID (matches Firebase Auth UID)

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL from Google Auth or custom

role.description: User role: admin, editor, or viewer

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user account was registered

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user last signed in

SiteSettings.title: SiteSettings
SiteSettings.description: Global website configuration including branding name, tagline, theme, and footer content.

footerContent.description: Custom text or description displayed in the footer

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when configuration was last saved

updatedBy.description: Email or ID of the admin who updated the settings

/history_records/{recordId}.description: Collection storing archived posts, reading history, and external reference links pushed from the SoroTrack browser extension.

/users/{userId}.description: Collection storing user accounts and roles managed by administrators.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Singleton or collection storing site name, tagline, theme, and footer content configuration.
